subject: Medlink: private VPC pricing, amortization & burst-commit proposal
messages:
From: Ciara Henry <ciara.henry@medlinksys.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medlinksys.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Private VPC pricing ask — 24mo commit + burst pool

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the performance profile looks solid for our edge inference use in EU clinics. Procurement asked me to get a clear commercial proposal for a private VPC deployment. High level asks from our side: 

- We can commit to a 24-month commercial term if pricing and cashflow are reasonable.
- We need a capped burst pool for seasonal peaks (up to 1.8x baseline). Can you outline how burst billing would work vs committed capacity?
- For the platform fee: can Redwood amortize it across the term rather than invoice up-front? If so, propose amortization options.
- Tax/invoicing note: Medlink prefers invoices split across two EU legal entities (Medlink NL and Medlink DE). Is that supported?
- Deliverables: we attached our draft SOW and procurement form — legal will send redlines.

Attached: Medlink_SOW_v1.pdf, Procurement_Form_Medlink.pdf (we'll send redlines separately).

Could you send a short proforma (line-item) showing committed vs burst pricing and suggested amortization approaches? We have a procurement window that closes on April 5.

Best,
Ciara
Head of IT Procurement | Medlink Systems

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Ciara Henry <ciara.henry@medlinksys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing ask — 24mo commit + burst pool

Ciara — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can support a capped burst pool and we generally offer amortization on the platform fee for committed terms; the exact schedule depends on the length of commitment and payment cadence.

I pulled together the high-level constructs so Legal/Finance can finalize:

- Committed baseline: priced per-node (operator + GPU SKU) with a 24-month discount tier — typically 18–24% off list at that commit level.
- Burst pool: metered at a lower incremental rate than on-demand but above committed; capped at 1.8x as requested; billing shows as 'burst usage' line item monthly.
- Platform fee amortization options we can offer: 12, 18, or 24-month amortization with a conditional rebate if production availability SLAs are met and tokens remain within projected thresholds at month 6/12.
- Invoice split: we support multi-entity invoicing for EU customers but need both VAT IDs and an invoice distribution agreement on the PO.

I've uploaded a reference ratecard here: https://drive.redwood.com/pricing/Redwood_Private_VPC_ratecard_Q1_2027.xlsx (copy attached). Marissa / Laura — can you review and add firm counters (rebates/milestones and any legal hooks)?

Next steps: Marissa, can you draft a commercial counter that shows (a) 24-month amortization over 18 months as a concession and (b) a capped burst discount rate? I'll circle back to Ciara by EOD tomorrow with a proforma.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Ciara Henry <ciara.henry@medlinksys.com>; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Medlink: commercial counter proposal (platform amortization + burst)

Ciara — looping in Laura for legal language. Per internal review, here's a practical commercial counter that should fit Medlink's procurement window. I attached a redline of the SOW with callouts.

Commercial counter (summary):
- Term: 24 months
- Platform fee: list = EUR 240k one-time. Concession: Redwood will amortize EUR 240k over 18 months on the customer's balance sheet (monthly invoice = EUR 13.333k) subject to a Production Acceptance milestone at month 3. If Production Acceptance is not achieved by month 4, remaining amortization will revert to immediate invoicing for the remainder of the term.
- Committed capacity: 10 operator nodes (mixed A100/T4 equivalent). Baseline monthly commit = EUR 95k (after committed discount).
- Burst pool: capped to 1.8x monthly baseline. Burst rate = 0.6x of list per-token incremental (i.e., discounted from on-demand), aggregated and billed monthly.
- Operator license discount: 20% discount on additional operator seats during months 1–12.
- Conditional rebate: if 99.5% prod availability is met for months 4–12, a one-time rebate of EUR 30k applied as credit on month 13 invoice.

Invoice split: we can accommodate split invoicing to separate legal entities. We will need the following from Medlink: (1) VAT IDs for both entities, (2) PO numbers for each entity, and (3) a signed invoice distribution consent form.

Attached: Medlink_SOW_redline_20270323.pdf, Redwood_Private_VPC_ratecard_Q1_2027.xlsx

Open items for procurement/legal:
1) Indemnity and data residency carveouts — Laura, please advise on any 'airgap' language Medlink requested.
2) Payment cadence — do they want monthly amortized invoices or quarterly? (affects cashflow/discount depth).
3) Tax handling across NL vs DE entities (Ciara to confirm).

If you agree, Karthik and I will produce a simple proforma that splits invoices as requested and shows the amortization schedule.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference
From: Medlink Procurement <procurement@medlinksys.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Ciara Henry <ciara.henry@medlinksys.com>; legal@medlinksys.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Medlink: commercial counter proposal (platform amortization + burst)

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the clarity. A few quick clarifying points from procurement and legal: 

1) Invoice split: we'll provide both VAT IDs today. Preferred split is 60/40 (Medlink NL / Medlink DE). Can Redwood produce two invoices monthly keyed to that split?
2) Payment cadence: Medlink prefers monthly amortized invoices (helps our forecasting).
3) Indemnity: Legal has flagged Section 8.2 — they want to limit Redwood's indemnity exposure for third-party data where Medlink controls ingress (we'll provide suggested language).
4) Taxes: Are platform fee amortization credits subject to VAT in your standard treatment? We need this confirmed for cross-border accounting.

I've attached our standard procurement form (Procurement_Form_Medlink.pdf) and will send legal redlines separately (legal@medlinksys.com).

Can you confirm whether the conditional rebate (EUR 30k) is payable as an invoice credit or a true cash refund? Also, please include the proforma with separate invoice lines for the NL/DE split. Procurement deadline: COB Fri, Apr 2.

Regards,
Medlink Procurement
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Medlink Procurement <procurement@medlinksys.com>; marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Ciara Henry <ciara.henry@medlinksys.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Medlink: commercial counter proposal (platform amortization + burst)

Thanks — quick legal/commercial clarifications and next steps so everyone has one source of truth.

1) Invoice split: yes, Redwood can issue two monthly invoices (60/40) provided we receive the VAT IDs and signed invoice distribution consent. We'll show the amortized platform fee as a single figure split pro rata across the two invoices.
2) VAT treatment: platform fee amortization treated as a supply of services; VAT treatment depends on which entity 'orders' the service. We'll confirm VAT treatment once we have the VAT IDs and the legal domicile information. Finance will annotate the proforma with a VAT placeholder until confirmed.
3) Conditional rebate: will be issued as an invoice credit (not a cash refund) to simplify cross-entity accounting. We'll mark the credit memo to apply to the primary NL invoice unless you request otherwise.
4) Indemnity redlines: Laura (legal@medlinksys.com) — we've reviewed and propose the following compromise: limit Redwood indemnity to direct losses up to EUR 2M and exclude indirect loss; carving out obligations for customer-controlled data ingress. We'll provide redline markup by tomorrow morning.

Action items / timeline:
- Marissa & Karthik: proforma (line-item) + amortization schedule delivered by EOD Thu, 25 Mar.
- Medlink procurement: provide VAT IDs + signed invoice distribution consent by Fri, 26 Mar.
- Legal teams: exchange indemnity redlines by Fri, 26 Mar to hit procurement window.

I'll attach a short proforma once Marissa posts it.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Legal | Redwood Inference
